content_html:
watched #Salaar : Eye Feast to Prabhas fans….get ready Salaar Part 2 🙏 and Prashanth Neel was right about Salaar being his version of Game of Thrones and Prabhas being John Snow 😉

Prashanth Neel Take a Bow….How many times you can use the same formula of elevations and actions and still come out with flying colours 🙏…. Salaar is 10X of KGF in Elevations, Violence & Stylish Fights, it’s just a What if scenario of What would happen if Prabhas did KGF 😍

Prashanth Neel made the best use of Prabhas Cut Out and have hardly gave him any dialogues which was a master stroke as in the recent movies we have seen the dialogue delivery of Prabhas has been ridiculous….This is the best usage of Prabhas which even Rajamouli failed to utilise!!!! Man he can give Goosebumps just with Shadow of Prabhas, he doesn’t even need his full cut out 🙇

There was nothing much to do for Prabhas apart from giving some breath taking poses in action episodes and elevation scenes….Prithviraj was the apt choice as Vardha and he took care of all the acting part 🫡 Tough Shruthi Hassan had a minor role she did her job well and especially her English Accent as NRI was too good 👍

Music by Ravi Basur was not extraordinary as it was in KGF but he did good job in elevation & action episodes…Special Call out to that Engine Starting Sound and those relevant dialogues from Kids when Deva is getting Triggered 😍

Content wise the First half reminded me of Prabhas very own Raghavendra movie and second half is a mix of multiple things…Tough every scene is not new and gibes us a feeling of being watched earlier but the impact it creates is worth watch

1000% Paisa Vasool if you are even a 0.1 % Prabhas Fan for others its a movie similar to the taking of KGF but Scaled upto 100 times 🙏
